newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trichet says banks onpass rate cuts readily enough.
newsitem.headline: Trichet says banks onpass rate cuts readily enough.

text.p: Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said in an interview with French weekly VSD that, overall, French banks were passing on interest rate cuts quickly enough to their customers.
The French government has criticised banks for not lowering their base lending rates fast enough to allow customers to take advantage of Bank of France official interest rate cuts.
When asked whether French banks were moving quickly enough to pass on the benefits of lower rates to consumers, Trichet said: "Yes, overall."
The interview will be published in Thursday's edition of VSD.
